'''Hound''' was an [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force trooper]] [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at a [[Republic military base|military base]] around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. He was among the many who searched the base after [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who was framed for [[Death/Legends|murdering]] [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]], escaped from her cell.

==Biography==
Hound was one of the millions of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] created on the aquatic [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], being trained for years as an Advanced Recon Force trooper. Hound, however, was specifically trained to be a massif handler.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Hound was part of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] and was stationed at [[Coruscant/Legends|the capital]]. Along with a [[Massiff/Legends|massiff]] named [[Grizzer (massiff)/Legends|Grizzer]], Hound searched the outside of a Republic military base for Ahsoka Tano, a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on the run for being framed in a murder she did not commit. When Grizzer caught Tano's scent, the massiff brought Hound to the spot where Tano had been hiding but seeing nothing, he went on with Grizzer to search the area. Hound would later take part in the chase after Tano and nearly corner the fugitive Jedi.

{{Char-stub}}

==Equipment==
Hound sported ARF trooper armor that was painted red, the color of the Coruscant Guard [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]], with the picture of a Massiff on his left shoulder pad. He wore a [[Kama/Legends|kama]] with holsters for [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]]. Hound was also known to occasionally carry a DC-15s blaster.
